protocol.name: EUR/USD H4 Breakout Retest Swing
protocol.dailyDirection: previous completed OANDA D candle only; EMA20/EMA50 plus close vs EMA20
protocol.breakout: H4 close through previous completed D1 high/low; previous H4 close still on the inside; no immediate entry
protocol.retest: 1 to 3 future H4 bars; freeze the broken D1 level; reclaim close with candle in trade direction; daily regime and H4 EMA20/50 still aligned
protocol.executionOfficial: stop-first; adverse stop gaps fill at the worse executable open; target gaps get no improvement; time exit at bar 30 close
protocol.executable: long ask in / bid out; short bid in / ask out; 1.5 ATR / 3.0 ATR rebuilt from frozen midpoint ATR around the executable entry; max hold 30 H4 bars
protocol.financing: FINANCING_DATA_UNAVAILABLE for historical OANDA swap. Bid/ask result is authoritative. Hypothetical sensitivities are labeled separately.

parity.note: OANDA H4 midpoint WR/PF/hold match the approximate TradingView 2023-2026 headline. N is a bit higher (occupancy still applied; leftover gap is consistent with OANDA D 17:00 NY versus TradingView D). Frozen rules were not changed. Both directions remain.
